Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and this is the Bucks' first game of the year, as they visit the Washington Wizards. Milwaukee's Jericho Sims and Nate Ament are both listed as day-to-day, with Sims's reason undisclosed and Ament's an ankle sprain, and both are game-time decisions. Washington will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out.

In the 2025-26 season series, the Bucks lost 1-3 to the Wizards, and their most recent meeting was a 109-99 loss in Washington on January 29, 2026.
